terms.etf: Waived when you close your account, as long as no bills are outstanding. Otherwise: HDB 1 and 2 room S$160; HDB 3 room S$220; HDB 4 room S$320; HDB 5 room S$380; HDB Executive, Jumbo or Multi-Gen S$460; condo, apartment or shophouse S$480; terrace S$720; semi-detached S$1,000; bungalow or penthouse S$2,000.

plans.evidence: Up to 8% off ( 3% off SP Regulated Tariff + 5% Prompt Payment Discount*)
plans.notes: EMA fact sheet read 2 Nov (same version as last week); price unchanged. Stored as 3% off tariff; the extra 5% prompt payment discount is conditional (kept as the promo, as in our data). Terms: the fact sheet waives the early termination charge on account closure if no bills are outstanding; our ETF wording lists only the amounts (same finding as 26 Oct, not yet approved).

issues: Prices unchanged (all 10 fact sheets same versions as last week). Terms: Classic 60's ETF waiver on account closure is still missing from our wording (re-proposed). Our deposit wording ('Varies by residential dwelling type') is vague but not wrong; the fact sheets list S$80-S$1,000 by home type. Promo notes: GETBACK24/GETBACK36 fact sheets now say 'first 250 sign-ups' (our promo title says first 100); code, value and end date unchanged. Savvy Saver 12 lists a YUU12 points promo to 31 Dec (we show none).
